name: smart-screenshot-desktop
description: Smart Screenshot Search Engine - Electron + React + Python Desktop App
author: Sakshi

scripts.kill-app: powershell -Command "taskkill /F /IM "Smart Screenshot Search Engine.exe" /T /FI "STATUS eq RUNNING" 2> $null; taskkill /F /IM electron.exe /T /FI "STATUS eq RUNNING" 2> $null"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run client-build && cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "cd backend_node && npm run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5001/health && electron ."
scripts.start: npm run client-build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production concurrently "cd backend_node && npm start" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5001/health && electron ."
scripts.pack: npm run client-build && npm run rebuild-backend && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run client-build && npm run rebuild-backend && electron-builder
